_comment: Business Studies -- Secondary School Teachers' Diploma syllabi, Years 1-2.
First typeset 2026-10-16.
TITLE / LEVEL / YEAR. "Business Studies" (the manuscript's cover says "Business Studies Syllabi");
Secondary School Teachers' Diploma as the Preface says; 2025 as on the copyright line.
SIX COURSES IN ONE BOOK (courses). Financial Accounting, Commerce, Teaching Methods for Commerce and
Principles of Accounts, Economics, Business Mathematics, Business and Company Law -- each with its own
description, competences and matrix. Each opens a section of its own and keeps its own year pages.
The course-span lines under the titles ("YEAR 1 TO YEAR 2", "YEAR 1 – 2") go: the year pages say it.
MATRIX NUMBERS. renumberMatrix: most numbers are broken Word list numbers (Commerce's topics ran
1.8 COMMERCE, 1.9, 1.10 ... after Financial Accounting's, Business Mathematics typed 2.1-2.3 inside
Year 1). Counted afresh from the table structure, Year.Topic within each course.
COVER. Deep burgundy (coverColour): the subject's own pick, #3d3d7a, is all but the indigo of Devices and
Material Production (#35306b); #7a1f3d is the one colour of the set no other syllabus uses.
ROUND 1 (2026-11-03): 113 Google Drive comments by Sylvia Shata Katongo and Harriet Kalapa (24 and 28 Oct 2026),
placed from the highlights in the reviewed copy and the comment e-mails. Cover green (#2e7d32: 'change colour cover
to green'; #1f5c3a is already Guidance and Counselling's and PE and Sport's). p108: Aghion and Howitt deleted (remove).

2026-11-11: CDC Social Sciences colour code is green (Mr. Musonda); all Social Sciences syllabuses one green, #0f6b3a (user 2026-11-11), with the peach band and dark Impact title of Civic Education Content.
ROUND 2 (Google Drive, Sylvia Shata Katongo, 12 Nov 2026): 2025 -> 2026 (year key: cover, footers; copyright and First Published lines).

ROUND 2 (Drive, 11-12 Nov 2026, 30 comments): p1/p3 year 2026 already done (12 Nov); Kalapa's 'full stops at the end of all the sentences in the descriptor columns' (p79, p102) -> fullStops, every course's descriptors alike

FRONT MATTER (user, 13 Nov 2026: front matter made standard for specialist verification): Duration of the Programme, typed as item c) of Admission Requirements, a sub-heading like the others; its '2 Years' (set as a list number + 'Years') -> 'Two (2) years.'

cells:
**Group Discussion**
• Explaining Inflation
• Discussing the types of inflation (demand-pull inflation, cost-push inflation…)
• Describing forms of inflation (deflation, hyper, galloping, creeping, stagflation…)
• Describing ways of measuring inflation rates (CPI, PPI, GDP deflator)
**Researching**
• Researching the Effects of Inflation (lower purchasing power, higher interest rates, slower economic growth, lenders and borrowers, retirees, weak trade unions…)
• Describing economic theories of inflation (The Quantity Theory of Money, Phillips Curve…)
**Demonstration**
• Illustrating aggregate demand, aggregate supply and inflation
• Evaluating Government intervention to counter inflation (Fiscal, Monetary, Prices and Incomes, Supply-Side Policies…)
